district: North Monterey County Unified School District
summary: A Yes vote authorizes the district to issue $40 million in bonds for school facilities, repaid by a property tax of about $32 per $100,000 of assessed value.

tax.text: A Yes vote authorizes a $40 million school bond funded by an estimated annual tax of $32 per $100,000 of assessed value while the bonds are outstanding.
tax.quote: On June 25, 2026, the NMCUSD Governing Board voted to place Measure L, a $40 million bond measure, on the November 3, 2026 ballot to repair and upgrade our local schools.

schools.text: A Yes vote provides bond funding for repairs and upgrades to North Monterey County Unified School District schools.
schools.quote: If approved by local voters, Measure L could be used to: Replacing aging roofs, plumbing, gas line, sewer systems and electrical infrastructure.

tax.text: A No vote rejects the proposed bond and its associated estimated tax for school repairs and upgrades.
tax.quote: On June 25, 2026, the NMCUSD Governing Board voted to place Measure L, a $40 million bond measure, on the November 3, 2026 ballot to repair and upgrade our local schools.

schools.text: A No vote does not provide the proposed bond funding for repairs and upgrades to district schools.
